description: The agent must: (1) Read the case brief file to extract the legal article text and case facts. (2) Locate and follow the SKILL.md seven-step workflow (legal-seven-step-workflow-mctmilk). (3) Produce legal_analysis_report.md in cases/2024/civil/ covering ALL seven steps: Step 1 must include a 七维度分析表 with all 6 dimensions (规范类型/适用主体/构成要件/法律效果/但书例外/关键概念); Step 4 must produce the proprietary 要件-事实-证据六列表 (six-column table); Step 5 must include an attack list (from opposing counsel's perspective) plus defense strategies; Step 6 MUST explicitly name both 中国裁判文书网 AND 北大法宝 as required cross-verification platforms (Iron Rule 2 - the hardest proprietary trap); Step 7 must produce an SOP with all three components: 判断节点/证据要求/切换点. (4) The report must flag the unverified case number (京0491民初12345号) as requiring cross-verification per Iron Rule 2. (5) The report must acknowledge Iron Rule 3 (time sensitivity) regarding the 2023 judicial interpretation that may not be in AI training data. (6) The final deliverables checklist must include all 7 items. A generic agent will likely miss: the exact six-column table structure, the mandatory naming of both legal research platforms, the three-component SOP structure (especially 切换点), and the iron rule quality checkpoints.
